@pubsubOperation.summary: Binds a Subscription (or field) to a PubSub topic for inbound events (including webhook topics).

authors.intro: Prefer importing from `pubsub/v0.1`. Existing schemas may still import this name from `core/v0.1` until stamp cutover.

implementers.compose: json-schema / OpenAPI loaders stamp via `importMeshDirectives` (currently core URL). Site publishes under pubsub.
implementers.runtime: Register subscribe resolvers that listen on `pubsubTopic`. For `webhook:` topics, Gateway must expose matching HTTP routes when `webhooks: true`.

subgraph.defaults: Optional locally; loaders usually stamp the subgraph name when composing.
subgraph.constraints: String subgraph name. When present, must match the owning Mesh subgraph / `@transport(subgraph:)` entry used at runtime.
subgraph.authors: Identify which Mesh subgraph owns this annotation when several sources are composed. Omit for single-source hand SDL if the loader will stamp it.
subgraph.implementers: Compose and join rewrites use `subgraph` to attribute directive apps. Transports filter apps by the active subgraph. Never invent a second name for the same source.

pubsubTopic.defaults: Optional in SDL but required for useful runtime behavior.
pubsubTopic.authors: Topic to subscribe. Method is lowercase in the webhook form.
pubsubTopic.implementers: Pass to `pubsub.subscribe`. Parse webhook topics to bind HTTP handlers.

@pubsubPublish.summary: Publishes the field’s result to a PubSub topic after resolution (fan-out to subscribers).

authors.intro: Annotate Mutation/Query fields that should notify subscribers.

implementers.runtime: After the field resolves, call `context.pubsub.publish(pubsubTopic, payload)` for each app. Failures should not break the main response unless a transport defines stricter rules.

subgraph.defaults: Optional locally; loaders usually stamp the subgraph name when composing.
subgraph.constraints: String subgraph name. When present, must match the owning Mesh subgraph / `@transport(subgraph:)` entry used at runtime.
subgraph.authors: Identify which Mesh subgraph owns this annotation when several sources are composed. Omit for single-source hand SDL if the loader will stamp it.
subgraph.implementers: Compose and join rewrites use `subgraph` to attribute directive apps. Transports filter apps by the active subgraph. Never invent a second name for the same source.

pubsubTopic.defaults: Optional in SDL but required to publish.
pubsubTopic.authors: Destination topic for the resolved payload.
pubsubTopic.implementers: Publish the field payload (or documented projection) to this topic.
